description: Create a Grafana annotation (POST /api/annotations) on the tenant's connection. Required: text. Optional: tags (array), time, timeEnd, dashboardUID, panelId.

dashboardUID.description: UID of the dashboard to annotate

panelId.description: ID of the panel to annotate

time.description: Start time of the annotation (epoch milliseconds)

timeEnd.description: End time for a region annotation (epoch milliseconds)

name: create_grafana_annotation
